integrity: The proof is deductive for all n>=2. Exhaustive checker validates n=2,...,9 only, not a replacement for proof. The numeric sequence is not claimed as newly discovered.
scientific_limitations: Only finite Gödel chains and normal, join-preserving, extensive, idempotent modalities. Independent audit not performed; existing general semigroup treatments could imply a reformulation. The numeric sequence was previously tabulated in OEIS A007070.
title: Commuting normal closure modalities on finite Gödel chains: a gap classification
